'''Marauder Reconnaissance Armor''', also known as '''Recon Marauder Armor''', was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] created by the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].

==Description==
As its name suggested, Marauder Reconnaissance Armor was a type of [[Armor/Legends|reconnaissance armor]], lightweight and appreciated for its cheap cost and mobility levels. This armor was usually made up of any available moldable materials that may have had some protective traits. Hence, its effectiveness could vary greatly, depending on the type of materials used and the skills of the [[armorsmith]]. Typical materials used to construct the armor included scaley hides, [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]], and fiber and [[Fiberplast/Legends|fiberplast]] panels. A typical complete set of armor comprised of a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], chest plate, left and right biceps, left and right [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], leggings, and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. It was available in several different [[Color/Legends|colors]].<ref name="SWG:RMA" />

==History==
Two other types of Marauder armor existed, including [[Marauder Battle Armor]] and [[Marauder Assault Armor]].<ref name="SWG:GU5" /> These armors, along with the Recon Marauder Armor, originated from their namesake [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]], a band of [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who found themselves stranded on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] in [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]]. Chief among them was [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]], the Sanyassan [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who led the pirate's from their [[Marauder's Stronghold|stronghold]]. Prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]] in about [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], Terak wore an entire suit of [[Color/Legends|bronze-colored]] Marauder Reconnaissance Armor, albeit without the gloves and helmet.<ref name="Ewoks" /> Terak was not the only Marauder to wear such armor. Fightmaster [[Jorak]] wore Recon Marauder Armor leggings and bracers, while the [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Szingo]] wore the bracers and chest plate.<ref name="Stronghold" /> Meanwhile, the Sanyassan [[Rydel Delan]], though not affiliated with the Marauders, likewise made use of the armor's chest plate and bracers.<ref name="SWG:TA" />

Circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], other organizations aside from the Sanyassan Marauders had adopted use of the recon armor. [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]], posted to the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]], were equipped with almost entirely full suits of the armor.<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> In their [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[White Thranta Shipping offices|offices]], [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security forces]] of the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]] incorporated Recon Marauder Armor Helmets as part of their [[Clothing/Legends|uniforms]].<ref name="SWG:SD" /> So too did Wilders and Marauders of the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]], a group of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|wielders]] who made their home in the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Recon Marauder Armor was also worn by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RMA" /> King Terak bestowed parts of the armor to one loyal servant.<ref name="SWG" /> Elsewhere on Endor, a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] encountered [[Macchbraus]], a Sanyassan armorsmith. Macchbraus, who had been outcast by his fellow Marauders, agreed to divulge the secrets on how to manufacture Assault and Recon Marauder Armor in exchange for being taught how to make other armors commonly worn by offworlders, including [[Bone armor|bone]], [[Composite armor|composite]], [[Mabari armor|Mabari]] and [[Padded armor/Legends|padded armor]].<ref name="SWG:GU5" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Marauder Reconnaissance Armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Initially, the Marauder recon armor was only worn by Marauder non-player characters in the original release of the game.<ref name="SWG" /> The armor was later made craftable and wearable by players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 5|Game Update 5]],"<ref name="SWG:GU5" /> on [[July 29]], [[2008]].<ref name="GU5">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67876&month=072008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 5}}</ref>
